UsnJournal.Attribute.name: ATTRIBUTE_UNSPECIFIED
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: Unspecified attribute.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: READ_ONLY
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: A file that is read-only.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: HIDDEN
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: The file or directory is hidden.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: SYSTEM
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: A file or directory that the operating system uses.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: ARCHIVE
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: Archive file or directory.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: COMPRESSED
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: A file or directory that is compressed.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: ENCRYPTED
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: A file or directory that is encrypted.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: DIRECTORY
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: The handle that identifies the directory.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: DEVICE
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: Reserved for system use.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: NORMAL
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: A file that does not have other attributes set.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: TEMPORARY
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: A file that is being used for temporary storage.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: SPARSE_FILE
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: A file that is a sparse file.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: REPARSE_POINT
UsnJournal.Attribute.description: A file or directory that has an associated reparse point.

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: OFFLINE

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: NOT_CONTENT_INDEXED

UsnJournal.Attribute.name: VIRTUAL

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.name: ACTION_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.description: The action type is not specified.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.name: EXEC
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.description: This action performs a command-line operation. For example, the action can run a script, launch an executable, or, if the name of a document is provided, find its associated application and launch the application with the document.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.name: COM_HANDLER
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.description: This action fires a handler. This action can only be used if the task Compatibility property is set to TASK_COMPATIBILITY_V2.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.name: SEND_EMAIL
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.description: This action sends an email message. This action can only be used if the task Compatibility property is set to TASK_COMPATIBILITY_V2.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.name: SHOW_MESSAGE
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskAction.ActionTy.description: This action shows a message box. This action can only be used if the task Compatibility property is set to TASK_COMPATIBILITY_V2.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.name: TASK_LOGON_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.description: The logon method is not specified. Used for non-NT credentials.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.name: PASSWORD
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.description: Use a password for logging on the user. The password must be supplied at registration time.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.name: S4U
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.description: Use an existing interactive token to run a task. The user must log on using a service for user (S4U) logon. When an S4U logon is used, no password is stored by the system and there is no access to either the network or encrypted files.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.name: INTERACTIVE_TOKEN
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.description: User must already be logged on. The task will be run only in an existing interactive session.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.name: SERVICE_ACCOUNT
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.description: Indicates that a Local System, Local Service, or Network Service account is being used as a security context to run the task.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.name: INTERACTIVE_TOKEN_OR_PASSWORD
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskLogonType.description: First use the interactive token. If the user is not logged on (no interactive token is available), the password is used. The password must be specified when a task is registered. This flag is not recommended for new tasks because it is less reliable than TASK_LOGON_PASSWORD.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.name: TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.description: The state of the task is unknown or not specified.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.name: DISABLED
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.description: The task is registered but is disabled and no instances of the task are queued or running. The task cannot be run until it is enabled.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.name: QUEUED
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.description: Instances of the task are queued.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.name: ACTIVE
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.description: The task is ready to be executed, but no instances are queued or running.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.name: RUNNING
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskState.description: One or more instances of the task are running.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: TRIGGER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: The trigger frequency is not specified.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: EVENT
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task when a specific event occurs.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: TIME
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task at a specific time of day.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: DAILY
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task on a daily schedule. For example, the task starts at a specific time every day, every other day, or every third day.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: WEEKLY
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task on a weekly schedule. For example, the task starts at 8:00 AM on a specific day every week or other week.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: MONTHLY
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task on a monthly schedule. For example, the task starts on specific days of specific months.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: MONTHLYDOW
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task on a monthly day-of-week schedule. For example, the task starts on a specific days of the week, weeks of the month, and months of the year.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: IDLE
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task when the computer goes into an idle state.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: REGISTRATION
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task when the task is registered.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: BOOT
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task when the computer boots.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: LOGON
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task when a specific user logs on.

WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.name: SESSION_STATE_CHANGE
WindowsScheduledTask.TaskTrigger.Trigger.description: Triggers the task when a specific user session state changes.
